FPGA Development Engineer

  This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
What You'll Do
Complete ownership of designing and delivering high quality FPGA design and verification environments.
Work with Board design, Signal integrity, Software development, Manufacturing, and sustaining teams on the program.
Deliver high quality Functional specification, Register definitions and Microarchitecture documents.
Work with large cross-functional and cross-geography team in capacity of FPGA engineer on an NPI program.

What You Need to Bring
BS/MS in Electronics/Electrical engineering with industry experience in FPGA/CPLD design and verification, preferably with networking background.
Career background of delivering complex designs and should have seen all phases of design life cycle from RTL to timing driven synthesis to place & route, static timing analysis.
Experience in bringing up the design and perform feature testing in the system.
Experience in using design tools from multiple FPGA vendors such as Xilinx, Altera and Lattice.
Experience of working on multiple protocols such as DDR-2/DDR-3/PCI/Utopia/POS-Phy/SPI/XGMII/XAUI/PCI Express/I2C and experience of designing high-speed interfaces using SerDes cores.
Strong debugging and lab skills are expected; should be comfortable with high-end oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and networking test equipment.
Knowledge of designing UVM-based verification environments is a plus.
Ability to deliver engineering as well as process innovations.
A team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Technical Support Engineer – Mist Assurance

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
At HPE, We Advance the Way People Live and Work
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is a global edge-to-cloud company built to transform businesses. We help customers connect, protect, analyse, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud.
Join us in shaping the future of connectivity. Our HPE Networking team combines AI-driven insights, cloud innovation, and next-generation wired and wireless technologies to deliver exceptional experiences for enterprises worldwide. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems, collaborating with world-class engineers, and redefining networking, this is your opportunity. Ready to change the world together?

Why You’ll Love HPE
Innovation at Core: Work on technologies like Multi-Cloud, Automation, IoT, AI/ML, and 5G—the backbone of digital transformation.
Inclusive Culture: We value trust, bold ideas, and continuous learning. Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of everything we do.
Impactful Work: Every solution you deliver helps global enterprises stay connected, secure, and ready for the future.

What’s In It For You?
Career Growth: Collaborate with product engineering teams and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies.
Continuous Learning: Deep dive into advanced networking, cloud solutions, and automation tools.
Skill Development: From troubleshooting complex networks to scripting and automation, you’ll sharpen both technical and soft skills.

What you'll do:
Triage and resolve customer-reported issues with a focus on delivering a positive customer experience.
Follow standard troubleshooting steps and predefined action plans to diagnose and resolve common issues.
Meet defined SLAs for response time, resolution time, and quality of customer communication.
Reproduce basic customer issues in test environments (using guided procedures) when required.
Analyse logs and system outputs to identify known issues and escalate appropriately when needed.
Collaborate with senior team members for complex issue resolution and knowledge sharing.
Maintain and update knowledge base articles and documentation to support faster issue resolution and team efficiency.
Demonstrate the ability to handle multiple tickets, prioritize tasks, and work independently with minimal supervision.

What You need to bring:
Must-Have Skills:
·  Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and team members. 
·  Basic troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve common network-related issues following standard procedures. 
·  Foundational understanding of: 
Networking concepts and switching basics (VLANs, STP, LACP, basic multicast concepts)
Core IP protocols (ARP, ICMP, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP)
Basic authentication concepts (802.1X, EAP basics)
Wireless fundamentals (802.11 standards, basic NAC concepts, PoE awareness)
Introductory routing knowledge (BGP and OSPF fundamentals)
·  Willingness to learn and adapt, with a proactive approach to developing technical skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:
Experience with Cloud Solutions
Certifications like JNCIA, CCNA, or Cloud/Wireless technologies

Who Should Apply?
Engineering graduates with 1-3 years of experience in technical support for enterprise/campus or cloud networks.
Professionals who love solving problems, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to make an impact.

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
